# سعر الذهب اليوم في الامارات (UAE Gold Prices)

> Live gold prices in the UAE in AED: 24K, 22K, 21K, 18K and 14K per gram and per troy ounce, by emirate, plus silver, platinum and palladium, a multi-currency table and a gold calculator. Arabic site.

Gold prices in the UAE follow the international spot price converted at the fixed AED/USD peg (3.6725). Shops add a making charge and 5% VAT on jewellery; investment gold of 99%+ purity is zero-rated.

## Prices

- [سعر الذهب اليوم في الامارات](https://uaegoldprices.ae/): today's prices per gram and ounce for every karat, 30-day summary, bars table
- [Privacy policy](https://uaegoldprices.ae/privacy-policy/)
- [About](https://uaegoldprices.ae/about-us/)
- [Contact](https://uaegoldprices.ae/contact-us/)
- [Financial disclaimer](https://uaegoldprices.ae/financial-disclaimer/)

## Calculations

- Karat price per gram = 24K price × fineness ÷ 999, with the fineness UAE price boards use: 24K 999, 22K 914, 21K 874, 18K 749, 16K 666, 14K 583 (other karats: karat ÷ 24)
- 1 troy ounce = 31.1034768 g; 1 tola = 11.6638038 g; 1 mithqal = 4.25 g
- Jewellery price = grams × karat price + making charge, then 5% VAT on both
- Zakat on gold: due when pure gold ≥ 85 g; 2.5% of its value

## Libraries

- [uae-gold-calculator source and docs](https://github.com/nbkdevs/uae-gold-prices): the calculations above as libraries for JavaScript, Python, Rust, Dart, C#, Ruby and PHP, with a CLI
